description.en: FinBalance is a multi-document accounting reconciliation benchmark built from 710 source-document bundles across eight industries, three period types, and five difficulty levels. It evaluates models on producing journal entries, balance sheets, and inconsistency labels, with a deterministic ledger for ground truth.
